import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*t + (p[2] + p[3]*t)*P + p[4]*P**2 + p[5]*t*P**2
            + p[6]/P + p[7]*t/P + p[8]*np.sin(p[9]*t))
